hypothesis: Shared continuous execution permits measuring bounded root-level quality differences. No LLM winner is assumed; null/adverse results satisfy the research question.
independent_variable: eight declared mission policies; identical model artifacts for within-model B3/B4 pairs
dependent_variable: Y=H*E*Q at the full 600-second deadline, with root-repeat means before domain/level aggregation
control_variables: shared qualified 240Hz PyFlyt physics and 120Hz control
same causal structured sensor model and public tools
same private root within paired methods
same 600s wallclock 1x; compute and link delays consume flight time
same infrastructure retry cap; policy failure stays a completed scored trace
no cross-root learning, memory, cache or prompt changes after G4

recording_semantics.seed_0: one root mean, not an extra flight, random seed or inferential replicate
recording_semantics.inner_sdk: separate complete classic and LLM rectangles, then complete outer root means; operational failures block aggregation

primary_inference.primary_family: architecture-M1, architecture-M2, selected-classic-M1, each in ID and OOD: global Holm6
primary_inference.classic_selection: All18 six-root B0/B1/B2 development slots must complete. Select B1 or B2 by equal-level macro Y; tie within1e-12 goes B1. Freeze signed result before main. Both classic-option contrasts above are descriptive SDK records; exactly one selected option enters primary six; the other never increases or replaces that family.
primary_inference.bootstrap: nominal pointwise diagnostic only; conservative finite bounded test is primary; no assumed power to detect .05

development_and_freeze.status: G1-G3 qualified in declared envelope; G4 unresolved; this research plan does not grant main/test access
route: admit bounded local model generation only via sole-owner reservations after plan acceptance
qualify prompts, B3/B4 public boundary, actual all-eight SDK, request accounting, clock contention and response semantics on development only
complete six-root all-eight clock/cost pilot with full failed/not_started slots and retain diagnostic generations
freeze final G4 source/model/prompt/generator/split/retry/source manifests with independent evidence review
generate main instances and run fixed schedule; no outcome-driven method changes
open holdout once with separate pre-open manifest; write evidence-bound paper only after accepted evidence and figures
development_and_freeze.selection_limits: Models are prospective families, not validated capabilities. Development failures are retained. Any unavailable or incompatible family blocks G4 until an explicit source-bound pre-test revision; no silent replacement or reduced condition matrix.
development_and_freeze.implementation_contract: The frozen evaluator and scientific design cannot change under this plan. Development actor/runner implementations and the final compatible generator are prospective outputs, independently qualified and frozen in a separate G4 manifest before any actual main/holdout cases. Bugs that change scoring, endpoints, populations, primary family or original promises require owner-governed re-planning, not an adapter bypass.

split_contract.root_identities_only: Listed IDs are planned slots, not generated instances or observed data. No main or holdout input exists yet.
split_contract.generation: Before G4 freeze distributions/ranges, physical feasibility and identity-crossing guards from development only, independent RNG streams and nonoverlap of root lineage across dev/main/holdout; close cousins and event siblings remain one lineage. OOD must change specified parameters without changing grading. No score-conditioned root rejection. Actual root seeds and generator bytes are committed before method dispatch.
split_contract.holdout_inference: Single descriptive replication of effect direction/size with complete bounded/nominal root-cluster intervals, no seventh confirmatory test and no method selection. Open only after main primary analysis is locked.

secondary_contract.SR: same root-repeat aggregation, level macro, cluster percentile intervals; never flattened Wilson
secondary_contract.events: preselected twelve L3 main IDs ID00..05 and OOD00..05; same root geometry/noise seed, clean sibling and event case; common event-demand calendar offline rescoring, preserve primary original calendar score; both siblings stay same bootstrap unit
secondary_contract.ablation: same twelve L3 roots; B4-M1 x3 repeats each removal of event trigger, cross-aircraft memory/dedup, progressive confirmation; shared grader never altered
secondary_contract.latency: separate observed local inference wall-time from paired synthetic injection delays0/2/5/10/20s; twelve selected L3 roots B4-M1 x3 for each arm; zero-delay arm may reuse only the exact compatible primary run, otherwise additional role-labeled run, never choose best repeat
secondary_contract.response_recovery: event applicable, response landed and recovery target defined before G4; failed recovery right-censored at fixed deadline; no-action-needed NA separate, never successful-only mean
secondary_contract.failure_traces: Select median-Y SR0 trace per method then lexicographic case/repeat tie, and lowest-Y shared-hard-violation trace; explicitly unavailable if stratum empty. No aesthetic/cherry-picked replacement.

attempt_policy.operational_retry: at most one retry for documented infrastructure process/service failure or clock lag>.1; identical frozen case/config and fresh method state, retain both; source/input/evaluator mismatch and unknown dispatch block, never auto-rerun
attempt_policy.policy_failure: malformed model reply, timeout under functioning request budget, rejected tool, missed target or unsafe execution retain original completed flight and actual Y, no resampling; no imputation of unstarted/unknown toY0
attempt_policy.late_model_result: actual wall wait recorded; after soft deadline ignore all late commands; physics continues during waiting; backend inability to cancel is disclosed and measured
attempt_policy.symmetry: same failure classes/cap for all conditions; no best-of-repeat or extra roots replacing failed ones

excluded_from_that_estimate: model loading, analysis, rendering and waiting
scope_and_cost.authorized_resources: existing local Mac, pinned downloaded local models, no paid API inference, no purchased compute, no submission/publication
scope_and_cost.metering: sole controller reservation/settlement with actual local request/input/generated tokens and unknown reconciliation; native Codex usage and local capital/energy unmetered; no false API price for local inference

stop_rule: No optional early stopping for significance. Any G4 failure or unresolved operational row blocks formal data/statistics. No reduction of19 obligations or8 methods without actual scope revision.
provenance: Initial prospective protocol; all earlier flight outcomes are development, never retroactively main data.
